description: Local-first model age lookup seed data for known brands and model families.

records.source: LG C3 launch cycle and retail release timeline
records.notes: LG C3 OLED televisions were introduced for the 2023 model year and remained in retail circulation into 2024.

records.source: LG front-load washer retail/manual publication window
records.notes: WM3470HWA aligns with LG front-load washer listings and manuals from the mid-2010s.
Samsung S90D OLED sets align to the 2024 model-year launch window and remained active in the following sales cycle.

records.source: Whirlpool French-door refrigerator retail/manual publication window
records.notes: WRF535SWHZ appears across late-2010s to early-2020s Whirlpool literature and retail listings.

records.source: Whirlpool WMH31017HS12 manual and retail publication window
records.notes: WMH31017HS12 is a current-generation Whirlpool over-the-range microwave sold in the mid-2020s, which rules out the older repeating 1994 serial cycle.
This GE Profile refrigerator model is associated with early-2020s production and sales cycles.

records.source: Rheem residential electric water heater product cycle
records.notes: This Rheem electric water heater model family aligns with late-2010s through early-2020s production windows.

records.source: Carrier condenser model family production window
records.notes: Carrier 24ABC6 series condensers are commonly associated with mid-2010s production.

records.source: Sony BRAVIA A80L product cycle and retail availability
records.notes: Sony A80L OLED televisions align with the 2023 BRAVIA lineup and continued through the following retail season.
This Bosch 500 Series dishwasher model appears in late-2010s through early-2020s manuals and retailer catalogs.

records.source: Maytag top-load washer launch and retail support window
records.notes: MVW7232HW is a current-generation Maytag top-load washer family associated with early-2020s production.

records.source: Frigidaire top-freezer refrigerator product listings and manuals
records.notes: FFHT1425VV appears in early-2020s Frigidaire literature as a compact top-freezer refrigerator model.

records.source: Frigidaire FEFL79DBB use and care manual / factory parts catalog publication window
records.notes: FEFL79DBB appears in early-2000s Frigidaire electric range manuals and parts literature, which aligns the model family to the 2004 production cycle rather than the later repeating serial decades.

records.source: Goodman GSX14 condenser family production window
records.notes: The Goodman GSX14 condenser family is commonly associated with mid-to-late 2010s installations and production.

records.source: Trane XR14 condenser family production cycle
records.notes: This Trane XR-series condenser model aligns with late-2010s to early-2020s production windows.

records.source: Apple part-number mapping and iPad 5th generation retail lifecycle
records.notes: MPGA2LL/A is an Apple iPad (5th generation) Wi-Fi configuration introduced in 2017. This is an iPad identifier, not an iPhone 8 family model.
